scope: four-class category classifier only, conditional on the upstream binary detector identifying malware
class_score_semantics: raw Random Forest class scores; not calibrated probabilities or confidence

rule.top_score: largest of the four class scores
rule.second_highest_score: second-largest of the four class scores
rule.tie_handling: a tied top score has margin 0 and is rejected as Uncertain

uncertain_semantics: The category model cannot safely distinguish a supported category; this does not mean benign.

selection_evidence.source: saved five-repeat package-grouped development OOF predictions only

selection_rationale: A coarse development-only grid showed strong separation by margin. The 0.70 cutoff approaches 99% accepted accuracy while retaining about 78% coverage; stricter cutoffs produced diminishing accuracy gains for larger coverage losses. Repeat and package-equal sensitivity checks did not reverse the conclusion.
